d:
You there, adventurer. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.
Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.
Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.
Blood and thunder, adventurer.
p:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.
If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
c:
Impressive, adventurer. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.
Lok-tar!

d:
There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.
Few believe such tales, but I do... Because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.
Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
